Our Story

From Our Farm to Your Family

Westwood Dairy was born from a simple dream: to bring the pure, wholesome taste of farm-fresh dairy to every household. For over 15 years, we've been dedicated to producing the finest yoghurt and Maziwa Mala using time-honored traditions.

Our cows graze on lush green pastures, and we use only natural fermentation processes. The result? Dairy products that are not just delicious, but truly nourishing.

🌿

100% Natural

No artificial additives or preservatives. Just pure, wholesome dairy.
